title: Dawn of Chromatica
scene: Queer hyperpop and deconstructed club remix community
notes: Adventurous multi-artist remixes splinter Chromatica into hyperpop, abrasive club music and genre hybrids.

title: Love for Sale
scene: Cole Porter / Great American Songbook; big-band vocal jazz
notes: Cole Porter standards place intimate jazz duets alongside lively swinging big-band arrangements.

title: Harlequin
scene: Character-led American standards, musical theatre, New Orleans jazz and surf rock
notes: Harley Quinn-inspired standards veer from brassy show tunes to surf guitars and vulnerable balladry.

title: Joker: Folie à Deux (Music From the Motion Picture)
scene: Hollywood jukebox musical; character-led live film performances
notes: Uneasy on-set vocals and darkened standards evoke Arthur and Lee rather than polished pop.
